author: austinbaustinb
content:
My wifi now has adblock!!! 
There is essentially just one ethernet port (fast internet through an ethernet cord) and a built in 'router' in the ceiling.
Router itself is a bit slow, and the only ethernet port had a cable running from it into the TV, so it was 'taken'. Turns out the TV was plugged in because the TV that came with the apartment can't connect to WiFi (wireless), so it needs the cable.

I pretty much needed to buy my own router that also worked as a 'switch', which is basically just a splitter but for those ethernet cables.
I plugged the TV into the router, can plug my laptop into it, and now I get a higher power router that I also get some control over. So, my phone and other devices now has better WiFi. And I get some cool control stuff.

But, Park Place WiFi has some security stuff built into it to be able to spy on me and prevent VPNs and some other stuff. Pretty much just blocked any of the websites I can use to download some third-party firmware for my router. Found some workarounds, did a lil 'hacking', and now I get like full control over this. 

As far as my WiFi goes, apps and websites will think I am logging in from chicago, and I also have 0 ads.
very excited

author: austinbaustinb
content: it is addicting though. With the firewall/security stuff and then the adblock, its got some more processing it has to do. This ends up making it to where the WiFi is a bit slower. Essentially from like 850 mbps to 200, which is a pretty big drop. If I threw more $ at it, I'd still be able to keep that 850mbps but wouldn't have to get rid of any security or WiFi stuff. Then if I were to move into a house back up north i could get fiber installed and then it'd be like hella quick
